mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."JPN_単語問題情報" ( "単語ID", "問題種別", "問題番号", "問題文_日本語", "問題文_中国語", "対象表記", "対象読み", "例文_日本語", "例文読み", "音声テキスト", "正解値", "正解補足", "解説_日本語", "解説_中国語", "難易度", "状態コード", "内容版数", "構造化JSON", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{wordId}, #{questionType}, #{questionNo}, #{questionJa}, #{questionZh}, #{targetHeading}, #{targetReading}, #{exampleJa}, #{exampleReading}, #{audioText}, #{correctValue}, #{correctNote}, #{explanationJa}, #{explanationZh}, CAST(#{difficulty} AS varchar), 'ACTIVE', #{contentVersion}, CAST(#{structuredJson} AS jsonb), NULL, 'BATCH' )

INSERT INTO public."JPN_単語問題選択肢情報" ( "問題ID", "表示順", "選択肢値", "選択肢読み", "正解フラグ", "誤答区分", "説明_日本語", "説明_中国語", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{questionId}, #{orderNo}, #{value}, #{reading}, #{correct}, #{wrongType}, #{descriptionJa}, #{descriptionZh}, NULL, 'BATCH' )
mapper.select: SELECT a."生成ID" FROM public."JPN_AI生成履歴情報" a WHERE a."単語ID" = #{wordId} AND a."内容種別コード" = #{contentType} AND a."状態コード" IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY a."生成ID" DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."JPN_AI生成履歴情報" ( "単語ID", "内容種別コード", "状態コード", "AI区分", "モデル名", "内容版数", "生成件数", "失敗件数", "開始日時", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{wordId}, #{contentType}, 'RUNNING', #{aiType}, #{modelName}, #{contentVersion}, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, 'BATCH' )
mapper.update: UPDATE public."JPN_AI生成履歴情報" SET "状態コード" = 'SUCCEEDED', "呼出履歴ID" = #{callLogId}, "生成件数" = #{generatedCount}, "失敗件数" = 0, "処理時間ms" = #{durationMs}, "終了日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "エラーコード" = NULL, "エラーメッセージ" = NULL, "更新元コード" = 'BATCH', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "生成ID" = #{generationId}

UPDATE public."JPN_AI生成履歴情報" SET "状態コード" = 'FAILED', "失敗件数" = "失敗件数" + 1, "エラーコード" = #{errorCode}, "エラーメッセージ" = #{errorMessage}, "処理時間ms" = #{durationMs}, "終了日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "更新元コード" = 'BATCH', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "生成ID" = #{generationId}
mapper.select: SELECT a."生成ID" FROM public."JPN_AI生成履歴情報" a WHERE a."状態コード" = 'QUEUED' OR (a."状態コード" = 'RUNNING' AND a."更新日時" < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{staleMinutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute')) ORDER BY a."生成ID" ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
